name: Battle of Yarmouk
summary: Khalid ibn al-Walid leads Arab Muslim armies against the massive Byzantine force under Vahan near the Yarmouk River in modern Jordan. Despite being outnumbered, the Arab cavalry exploits a dust storm to shatter the Byzantine line. The six-day battle ends Byzantine rule over Syria and Palestine, territories lost to Rome for centuries. Jerusalem falls the following year.

_quarry.structural_significance: Permanently ends Byzantine control of the Levant, Egypt follows in 641; establishes Islamic dominance over the eastern Mediterranean coast for the next four centuries
